rubric: 6 to 8 ranked ideas, each with the gift in a few words, a price band, one line on why it fits this person, and a practical note.
The kinds are mixed (experience, useful upgrade, consumable, personal or hand-made, a plus-one); each idea ties to a fact the user gave.
A pick with a reason; cultural and personal fit kept (no alcohol where unwanted, customs for holidays, stated dislikes respected).
No invented shops, product names or exact prices; budget bands named when the user gave none.
A card text of 2 to 4 sentences in the user's voice when asked, with the name and one specific memory or trait.
